notes: v2.9.49: mobile whole-candidate auto-trading no longer depends on the watchlist. The mobile ALL scope now always uses the seven danta condition scanners as the candidate pool, automatically starts the condition-search stream when needed, then applies PUMA secondary filtering and the existing Gaboja entry rules. The mobile candidate-source control is fixed to this path so stale WATCHLIST settings cannot block startup. Selected-stock mode remains available. Trading strategy and signal rules are unchanged.
